# Army Medical (TPUB)

> Comprehensive repository of Army Medical Department training manuals and reference materials covering field medicine, preventive medicine, medical logistics, and healthcare ethics.

Army Medical is an official training and reference resource providing standardized medical education for Army Medical Enlisted Dental and Medical (AMEDD) personnel. The site offers foundational through advanced training materials on military medical operations, clinical skills, organizational structures, and professional standards.

## Key Topics

- Army Medical Department (AMEDD)
- Field Medical Evacuation
- Preventive Medicine
- Health Service Support
- Medical Logistics
- Military Healthcare
- Medical Terminology
- Healthcare Ethics
- Epidemiology and Microbiology
- Medical Imaging and Radiography
- Battalion Aid Station
- Federal Tort Claims Act
- Geneva Convention
- Communicable Disease Control
- Army Medical Training

## Core Operations and Organization

- [Organization and Functions of the Army Medical Department](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0004): Reference on Army Medical Department organization and Surgeon General structure
- [Evacuation in the Field](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0001): Training manual on field medical evacuation, triage, and casualty handling
- [Health Service Support in a Theater of Operations](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0002): Manual covering health service support in military theater operations
- [Army Preventive Medicine Units, Organizations, and Activities](https://armymedical.tpub.com/md0150): Reference on Army preventive medicine organizations and medical corps structure

## Clinical and Medical Foundations

- [Basic Human Anatomy](https://armymedical.tpub.com/md0006): Training manual covering human anatomy, anatomical terminology and body regions
- [Basic Human Physiology](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0007): Educational manual on human physiology, body fluids, and homeostasis
- [Basic Medical Terminology](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0010): Educational manual on medical terminology, prefixes, suffixes and components
- [Principles of Epidemiology and Microbiology](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0151): Training on epidemiology, microbiology, and communicable disease control

## Preventive Medicine and Disease Control

- [Introduction to Military Preventive Medicine](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0008): Training manual on preventive medicine, immunization, and disease control
- [Diseases of Military Importance](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0152): Training manual on military diseases, prevention, and food-water-borne illness

## Professional Standards and Ethics

- [Health Care Ethics I](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0066): Training on healthcare ethics, patient rights, and professional conduct
- [Health Care Ethics II](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0067): Training on informed consent, physician responsibility, and ethical standards
- [Tort Law, The Federal Tort Claims Act, and the Geneva Convention](https://armymedical.tpub.com/md0033): Legal training manual on tort law, Federal Tort Claims Act, and conventions

## Medical Imaging and Quality Assurance

- [Introduction to Radiography](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0064): Training manual on radiography, X-ray history, and medical imaging
- [Introduction to Quality Assurance](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0062): Training on quality assurance in radiography and medical imaging

## Logistics and Support Systems

- [Introduction to Medical Logistics Management](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0029): Training on Army medical logistics, supply chain, and materiel management

## Optional: Technical Foundations

- [AMEDD Computer Literacy I](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0057): AMEDD training on computer history from mechanical calculators to electronics
- [AMEDD Computer Literacy II](https://armymedical.tpub.com/MD0058): AMEDD training on number systems, binary conversion, and Boolean logic
